correctness.rationale: The shear factorization is invertible over each residue ring, and testing the standard basis is equivalent to testing the global permutation order. At valuation e≥2, squaring I+2^eE raises the difference valuation by exactly one; successive mod-2 reduction kernels can only contribute powers of two to the order. For even C the first valuation is r, and at r=1 the upper-right block 2C+C³ gives exact valuation two after squaring. For both parameters odd the mod-two block C is nonzero with C²=0, the first square has difference valuation one, and (M²−I)/2 squares to zero mod two, so the fourth power has exact difference valuation two. With opposite parities the order mod two is three, and the block factor C²(C²+3I) is 4I or 4 times the exchange matrix mod eight, while all blocks of M³−I vanish mod four. The resulting law includes the plateau at s=1,2, signed weights, and M=I when k=c=0. Scalar orders follow from the same identities; the minimum valuation of k±c increases by one exactly at equal finite valuations, giving the claimed factor precisely below depth s. The rational change of basis is not invertible at 2. Independently iterating the shears on every basis vector to first return verified 582 coupled cases (all residues through depth four, signed samples at five and six), including the scalar comparison.
residual_risks: Regression is finite; the congruence seeds and lifting prove the uniform law. The law is not an individual orbit census.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Even if read as an assertion for arbitrary two-site weights, it would give 6 mod four when T(2;2)=3 for C equal to the exchange matrix; the exact block check gives 3. It cannot be used as a valid stronger law for the arbitrary frozen family. No assertion about whether the contextual special-family scaling is correct is needed here.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Solving a rational eigenmode problem or finding the least exponent satisfying an unsolved matrix congruence is not an equivalent evaluation of the orders on the integral torus. Mode division by 2 is invalid there.
